en.html:
The metallic voice warned of danger.

Danger—yes. Dangerous!

I pushed questions into a corner of my head and forced a change of thought.

That thing descending on human settlements could not end well.
Not the Gulliver of a fanciful travelogue. Expect consideration for the little people's world from a man drunk on divine power? Far too hopeful.

Besides, whatever its shape, still God—the source of contamination spreading worldwide.

Only one thing for me to do.

ja.html:
劒冑の金打声が危険を告げる。

　危険――そう、これは危険！
　俺は異常事態への疑問を頭の隅に追いやり、思考の
切り替えを己に強要した。

　あんなものが人里へ降りて、無事に済む筈もない。
　空想旅行記の<ruby>巨人<rt>ガリバー</rt></ruby>とは違う。〝神〟の力に酔う風の
あの男に<ruby>小人<rt>・・</rt></ruby>の世界への配慮を期待するのは、希望的
観測が過ぎている。

　加えてあれは形こそ変われど〝神〟、全世界に蔓延
してゆく汚染波の源なのだ。
　
　俺のやるべき事は一つだった。

en.html:
No longer a beast squandering gravity.
Its vast power was under a veteran warrior's control. It had even changed into the shape he handled most naturally—a Saturn.

Absent tactical thought had evolved into cunning.
Crude power use had become dramatically efficient.

No doubt.
Comparison now simple.

Initially, God had complete superiority in power; I, in tactics.
With Nagasaka as its brain, tactics approached equality. Still, it seemed disadvantaged by controlling an unfamiliar form.

No longer a beast squandering gravity.
Its vast power was under a veteran warrior's control. It had even changed into the shape he handled most naturally—a Saturn.

Absent tactical thought had evolved into cunning.

With Nagasaka as its brain, tactics approached equality. Still, it seemed disadvantaged by controlling an unfamiliar form.

既にあれは重力操作を放漫に駆使する<ruby>怪獣<rt>モンスター</rt></ruby>ではない。
　その膨大を極める<ruby>力量<rt>エネルギー</rt></ruby>を、老練なる武人の制御下に
置かれ、しかも彼が最も操りやすい<ruby>竜騎兵型<rt>かたち</rt></ruby>へと変貌
すらしている――<ruby>魔神<rt>サターン</rt></ruby>なのだ。

　皆無であった戦術構想は狡猾な進化を、

en.html:
Another school, but I had strangely frequent dealings with it. Some knowledge.

Its sword posture was solid.
Look closely, however: a thread's-width opening.

The pitfall.

A perfect defence might make the enemy think and invent an unexpected method.
To prevent that, leave an opening deliberately.

Let the opponent dance inside one's expectations. Waste strength, skill, timing.
Then victory came easily.

—Defeat the enemy by giving life: the Life-Giving Sword.

Divine power strengthened the principle.
Even a mistake in defence, an enemy cut received, would not make that body suffer.
The returning sword needed only graze to slaughter.

A formula for certain victory.

—Against it, I—

　魔神の剣形は如何にも堅牢なもの。
　だが詳細に目を凝らせば、糸筋程度の隙が見える。

　完璧に防御を固めれば、対敵は考えを巡らせたすえ、

　我が想定の範囲内で敵を踊らせ、力と技と機を無為
に費えさせるのだ。さすれば勝利はいとも容易い。

en.text:
Such divine power.
Such Nagasaka's obsession.

Even inside absolute annihilation, he struggled to endure…!◆

Could not permit it.

One more blow would surely destroy him.

Did the struggling god know it too?
Power swirled, heedless of running wild. At the centre of a vast crucible of chaos, he howled and bellowed.
